subject: Pilot playbook & ground-truth eval — next steps for Bridgewell Health
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@bridgewellhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: bridgewell-salesops@bridgewellhealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — grounding pilot

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. I wanted to put a short summary of what my team needs from Redwood to get a small pilot started and to confirm a couple of assumptions:

- Goal: Improve answer grounding for patient-facing clinical guidance (documents: policies, formularies, intake notes). Target: precision@1 >= 0.78 on the sample set, hallucination rate < 6%.
- Data: we'll share ~2k de-identified Q/A pairs and 150 documents for initial indexing.
- Success criteria: quality regression detection, clear fallback behavior, and cost estimates for steady-state ~250 QPS.

Can you send recommended model variants, the evaluation probes / prompt sets you propose, and the retrieval + reranker settings you think make sense for our content? Also please include a short ops playbook (what we should expect during the 4-week pilot).

Attachments: bridgewell-call-notes.pdf (we dropped the raw notes).

Aisha
Head of Product, Bridgewell Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot playbook & eval artifacts — Bridgewell next steps

Hi Aisha —

Great to chat — below is a concise pilot playbook and the evaluation artifacts we'll deliver as part of the kickoff. High-level notes followed by concrete asks.

Summary recommendations (short):
- Model candidates: "redwood-7b-v2-q4" (fast, cost-efficient) and "redwood-13b-quant" (higher fidelity for long-context clinical grounding).
- Retriever settings (initial): chunk_size=400 tokens, overlap=64, encoder=embedding-v2, top_k_candidates=60.
- Reranker: start with "cross-encoder-rerank-v2" for quality-first testing; switch to "light-re-rank-v1" for cost-constrained production once thresholds hold.
- Grounding metrics: precision@1, precision@3, faithfulness score (binary citation match), and hallucination-rate (%) with a deck of targeted adversarial prompts.

What Redwood will provide in Week 0–1 (artifacts):
- Benchmarks: rw-benchmarks-bridgewell.csv (baseline model runs on your sample prompts). Attached.
- Prompt sets: 3 prompt families (QA canonicalization, clarifying funnel prompts, and user-facing short answer templates). We will share config for deterministic evals.
- Ops playbook PDF: pilot-milestones-SoW-draft.pdf (attached) with milestones and rollback criteria.

Proposed evaluation plan (Week 1–3):
1) Ingest your 150 documents into a sandbox index; verify chunking and metadata coverage.
2) Run a 2k Q/A probe against both model candidates with current retrieval settings to capture precision/recall and hallucination signals.
3) Run reranker ablation: compare cross-encoder-rerank-v2 (expensive, high-quality) vs light-re-rank-v1 (cheap) on top_k_candidates=60, measure P@1/P@3 delta and cost/latency.
4) Establish regression checks (daily automated runs + human review sample of 50 mismatches).

Operational asks for Bridgewell (what we need from you):
- Confirm the 2k de-identified Q/A set and provide S3 link or Drive folder.
- Provide security contact for SOC2/DSR questions and any IP constraints (we'll sign an addendum if needed).
- Confirm desired weekly sync cadence (we propose Tues 10am PT).

Next steps:
- Ben will scope the initial benchmark runs and Soojin will own reranker ablation. We aim to deliver a benchmark CSV and an eval dashboard link by Tue EOD (Aug 17).

If this looks correct I can send a short MOU and a pilot SoW for signature.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0197

Attachments: rw-benchmarks-bridgewell.csv (benchmark stub), pilot-milestones-SoW-draft.pdf (SoW stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook & eval artifacts — internal notes

Quick internal note — pinning a few concrete numbers and an evaluation checklist before we run anything:

Retrieval / indexing
- chunk_size: 400 tokens (as Evelyn suggested)
- overlap: 64 tokens
- metadata to index: doc_type, section_id, source_date, confidentiality_flag
- embed model: embedding-v2 (1280d) with per-corpus normalization

Reranker plan
- Run cross-encoder-rerank-v2 on top_k_candidates=60, then rerank_top_n=8. Measure latency at 1, 10, 250 QPS.
- If P@1 (cross-encoder) - P@1 (light-rerank) < 0.06 and cost delta > 3x, recommend light-rerank for production.

Evaluation suite / metrics
- Primary: precision@1, hallucination_rate (annotated by human labelers), mean_answer_latency (ms).
- Secondary: precision@3, redundancy-rate (duplicate source citations), faithfulness binary agreement.
- Regression thresholds: any daily drop in P@1 > 0.04 triggers a rollback to previous model + alert.

Benchmarks to produce by Tue EOD (Aug 17):
1) baseline CSV for both model candidates over the 2k probes (attached to Evelyn's note).
2) reranker ablation CSVs (cross vs light) + per-query latency percentiles.
3) short ops-runbook (how to revert to fallback model).

I'll kick off the runs on our sandbox cluster this afternoon. Soojin, can you prepare the reranker ablation config and the annotation spreadsheet for hallucination labeling?

- Ben
Principal ML Solutions Engineer

Notes on cost/production guidance:

- Operational fallback: if daily P@1 drops > 0.04 we will automatically failover to the previous validated checkpoint and notify your team.

Security & paperwork: please loop in your security contact or provide a preferred NDAs/PO for the dataset transfer; our security contact is security@redwood.ai if they need the SOC2 packet.
